info.title: UdyamPulse API
info.description: Decision intelligence for MSME manufacturing credit: consented operating data → explainable Factory Health Score → credit memo → human decision → continuous early warning. All AI outputs are recommendations; the credit officer decides. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`).

schema.title: Response Me V1 Auth Me Get

get.description: KPI tiles for the console. Decision figures count only decisions made in this system (not seed data).

schema.title: Response Application Stats V1 Applications Stats Get
Response List Applications V1 Applications Get
Response Create Application V1 Applications Post
Response Get Application V1 Applications  App Id  Get
Response Grant Consent V1 Applications  App Id  Consent Post
Response Revoke Consent V1 Applications  App Id  Consent Delete
Response Consent Ledger V1 Applications  App Id  Consent Ledger Get
Response Draft Memo V1 Applications  App Id  Memo Post
Response Decide V1 Applications  App Id  Decision Post
Response Disburse V1 Applications  App Id  Disburse Post

post.description: Right to challenge an AI-assisted outcome (RBI FREE-AI): routes the case to a human reviewer.

schema.title: Response Request Review V1 Applications  App Id  Review Request Post

get.description: Full text of one credit-policy clause, for the citation chips in the memo.

schema.title: Response Policy Clause V1 Policy  Section  Get
Response Levers V1 Score Levers Get

post.description:
Re-score with a few signals changed over the latest months. Nothing is stored: the application's
score, band and state are untouched and no data pull is recorded.

schema.title: Response Simulate V1 Score Simulate Post

get.description: Score-band migration of monitored accounts between the previous and the latest visible month.

schema.title: Response Migration V1 Portfolio Migration Get

get.description: Staff who can own an alert (for the assign menu).

schema.title: Response List Alerts V1 Alerts Get
Response Action Alert V1 Alerts  Alert Id  Action Post

post.description: Assign an owner to, or acknowledge, several open alerts in one step.

schema.title: Response Bulk Alerts V1 Alerts Bulk Post
Response Clock V1 Sim Clock Get

post.description: Fast-forward the simulated clock, then let the early-warning agent process newly visible data.

schema.title: Response Advance V1 Sim Advance Post
Response Readiness V1 Msme  Factory Id  Readiness Get

put.description: Tick or untick one step of the 90-day plan.

schema.title: Response Set Plan Step V1 Msme  Factory Id  Plan Steps  Step Key  Put
Response Notifications V1 Msme  Factory Id  Notifications Get

get.description: DPDP data-principal rights stub: what is held, why, and the consent history.

schema.title: Response My Data V1 Msme  Factory Id  My Data Get
Response Erasure Request V1 Msme  Factory Id  Erasure Request Post

get.description: Model inventory entry: metrics, fairness, drift, EWS back-test and the model card.

schema.title: Response Model Inventory V1 Model Get

get.description: Portfolio-wide consent ledger: grants, data pulls, blocked pulls, expiries, revocations, deletion jobs.

schema.title: Response Consent Ledger V1 Consent Ledger Get

get.description: Every LLM-writer call: prompt template, provider, latency and a token estimate (characters / 4).

schema.title: Response Ai Usage V1 Ai Usage Get

post.description: Presenter control: restore the seeded demo state. Available only in demo mode (local synthetic data).

schema.title: Response Reset Demo V1 Demo Reset Post
Response Demo Status V1 Demo Status Get

get.description: Liveness: the process is running. Checks no dependency, so a slow database never restarts the pod.
Readiness: database, model artifact and lake are reachable. 503 takes the pod out of rotation.
